$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

AbstentionDecision.description:
How the abstention policy was applied (3.5). Exact processing over
model-derived masses; the thresholds are not calibration claims.

oneOf.description: A label accepted under the request's explicit label-only posture.

AbstentionRule.description: The abstention rule that refused a distribution.

oneOf.description: A valid output.
The decision deadline passed while it was in flight.
The caller cancelled while it was in flight.
The backend confirmed that its work and charges stopped.
The backend answered without confirming a remote stop.
The runtime stopped waiting before any answer.

Cancellation.description: What is known about cancelling an attempt (spec 003, 3.7.3).

Charge.description: What an attempt cost, as far as is known when it ends.

CostBound.description: A backend's per-call cost disclosure, before dispatch.

oneOf.description: The call cannot cost more than this.
Every call has an enforceable upper bound.
Calls have estimates, not bounds.

CostSummary.description: A decision's cost at the moment its record was built (spec 003, 3.5.6).

liability.description: Reservations kept because the final cost is unknown.

within_guaranteed_cap.description: True only under `hard` with no liability and no bound violation.

Disclosure.description: What a served identity is worth (spec 009, 3.7).

oneOf.description: The remote side guarantees the identity.
The remote side said so; unverified.
Nothing is known. Never replaced by a requested model or a slug.

DynamicAnswer.description:
What was proposed (3.6). A label is only a label; a distribution is
uncalibrated mass, not a calibrated probability; an ordinal distribution
is mass over ordered levels, not an interval score.

oneOf.description: `label` is the top label; ties go to the earlier declared label.
`level` is the top level; ties go to the lower level.

DynamicLineage.description: What a proposal was computed from (3.6).

context.description: The context field names, in request order.

exact_processing.description:
Exact processing applied after the backend, in order (`validate`,
then `abstention`); visible, never a relabeling.

DynamicOperation.description:
The three dynamic operations (3.2). Their names are R-05's; `rank`,
`generate` and `extract` are not dynamic operations in version 1.

DynamicOutputKind.description:
The output kind a request requires (3.2): `label` for any operation,
`distribution` for `proposition` and `classify`, `ordinal_distribution`
for `rubric`. A distribution is never a calibrated probability, and an
ordinal distribution is never an interval score (3.6).

DynamicProposal.description:
A dynamic proposal (3.6): always `model-derived`, with the request and
backend output in its lineage. Never a grant, never a plan value.

oneOf.description: Nothing was dispatched.
The backend's answer, exactly as returned.
The adapter reported a failure.
No answer was received: deadline or cancellation.

DynamicRawOutput.description:
What a dynamic backend returned, before validation (3.3). Material that
is not a label or a distribution (a tool call, instructions, a schema, a
URL to fetch, an action) is carried as `unrecognized`, recorded as
invalid output and never executed.

oneOf.description: Masses keyed by label or level.

excerpt.description: At most 256 bytes of the material, as data.

DynamicRefusal.description: Why a request was refused before dispatch (3.4, 3.5).

oneOf.description:
The backend declares no dynamic capability; a registered-plan
descriptor never suffices.
The declared capability fails its own structural bounds.

The declaration is for another backend or artifact than the request
requires.
The request does not fit a declared limit without truncation.
The cost model is not `bounded`, so no enforceable bound exists.
The per-call disclosure is not an enforceable bound.
The enforceable bound is above the cap.
A host ledger cannot hold the reservation.

DynamicResult.description: A proposal or a named unresolved outcome (3.5, 3.6).

DynamicTiming.description: Monotonic milliseconds from the start of the request.

DynamicUnresolved.description:
A named unresolved outcome (3.5). No neutral score, first label,
majority label, empty distribution or provider confidence replaces it.

oneOf.description: Refused before dispatch.
The adapter reported a failure; no second request follows.

The output is outside the declared labels, levels, kind or support,
or not an answer at all.
The pinned served identity differs from the one served.

DynamicValidation.description:
Exact validation of the raw output (3.3, 3.6). Exact processing: it
never relabels the proposal exact-derived.

FailureClass.description:
How a dispatched attempt failed (spec 003, 3.6.1). Deadline and
cancellation are not classes: they end a request, and are never retried
or a fallback trigger.

oneOf.description: The output failed the core's validation.
The adapter says the failure may not recur.
The adapter says the backend refused for load.
The adapter says the failure will recur for this input.
The attempt timeout passed.
The adapter panicked.

LabelMass.description: One label's or level's mass, in declared order.

oneOf.description: The backend returned a result of its own accord.
The backend acknowledged a cancellation as stopped.
Nothing establishes that remote work or charges stopped.

ResponseShape.description: The shape of response material that is not an answer (3.3).

oneOf.description:
A distribution with a NaN or infinite mass: JSON cannot carry the
masses, so the outcome records them as an excerpt (3.3, 3.6).

Scope.description: The isolation scope of a capture, a bundle and every request identity.

oneOf.description:
Reuse across principals within one tenant and context revision: an
explicit host assertion that the computation is principal-independent
and that the host authorizes every reader (spec 004, 3.1.4).

Reuse only within one tenant, context revision and effective
principal scope. The default.

TaskFamily.description: A task family and its version, selected from a host allowlist (3.2).

TemplateRef.description:
A structured template, identified by its producer (3.3, 3.4): the
versioned mapping from request fields to the provider's request, with
fixed control instructions no caller value can enter.

description:
A dynamic outcome, `rustev.dynamic-outcome/1` (3.6): evidence of what
Rustev observed for one request, bounded by `RECORD_V1`. It is not proof
that the context was true, the backend was correct, privacy options were
honored, or an action was permitted.

attempt.description: The one attempt; absent when nothing was dispatched.

capability.description: Absent when the backend declares no dynamic capability.

cost.description: The request's own ledger: mode `hard`, limit the cap.

privacy.description: The privacy options requested; recorded, never proof of handling.

request.description:
The canonical request identity; absent only when no capability was
declared to bind its template and preprocessing.

requested_artifact.description: The artifact the request required; never replaced by a served one.

served.description: The served identity as the backend reported it, or `unknown`.

title: rustev.dynamic-outcome/1
